segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: As Jesus traveled toward Jerusalem, a Samaritan village refused to welcome Him. The disciples James and John were hot with anger.

segments.speaker: scripture
segments.text: Lord, wilt thou that we command fire to come down from heaven, and consume them, even as Elias did?

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: They asked if they should call down fire from heaven to burn the place. They wanted judgment.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Jesus turned and rebuked them — not the village, but His own disciples' hearts.

segments.speaker: jesus
segments.text: Ye know not what manner of spirit ye are of. For the Son of man is not come to destroy men's lives, but to save them.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: He didn't come to burn. He came to rescue. The fire in the disciples' hearts was the wrong kind.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: And then they simply walked on to the next village. No fire. No answer to the insult at all — just the road, and somewhere else to be.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Anger that wants to destroy isn't from Him. The spirit He brings saves.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: He came to save, not to burn. Let His Spirit — the saving one — shape yours.
